name: elevenlabs
summary: Completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created example.py with the quickstart code, and ran it. The script successfully generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 46KB, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, mono) from the text input. The core promised outcome — text-to-speech generating an audio file from text — is verified.
deviations: 1. Did not create a .env file because ELEVENLABS_API_KEY was already exported in the sandbox environment. 2. Added code to save the audio generator to a file (output.mp3) so the result could be verified in this headless sandbox (no speakers). 3. Wrapped the `play(audio)` call in a try/except since the sandbox has no audio output device; the play failure is expected and does not affect the core outcome.

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
